title: CoreWeave signs 12-year, ~200 MW hosting deals with Core Scientific (>$3.5B)

sources.quote: Once the approximately 200 MW of HPC infrastructure is operational, the project is estimated to generate total cumulative revenue for Core Scientific of over $3.5 billion during the initial 12-year terms of the contracts.

explain: CoreWeave agreed to rent about 200 megawatts of converted bitcoin-mining sites from Core Scientific for 12 years to house its Nvidia GPUs. Core Scientific expects more than $3.5 billion in revenue over the contracts.
